تبتاعوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَاعُوا (tabtāʕū) /tab.taː.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
# تُبْتَاعُوا (tubtāʕū) /tub.taː.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
